purpose: define non-promotable construction payloads for research-lab validation

baselines.label: Known losing SMA churn baseline
baselines.known_property: High-turnover opposite-direction SMA crossover construction intended to produce cost-drag and gate-failure behavior when a later package executes it.

baselines.label: Known no-trade unreachable-threshold baseline
baselines.known_property: Closed-condition SMA / StdDev construction whose declared entry threshold should remain unreachable or no-trade in later execution, validating empty-result and denominator behavior.

baselines.label: Known invalid denominator-preservation baseline
baselines.known_property: Declarative invalid-parameter construction using existing SMA lookback semantics, intended to preserve invalid/blocked rows without strategy execution.

blocked_or_deferred_requirements.summary: Strategy Spec / Variant Manifest / Sweep Plan schemas do not currently accept exact construction_payload and non_promotable provenance fields.
Later gate, agent-loop, dashboard, and crossing consumers must implement explicit hard rejection of construction payloads before exercising these baselines.
